//: Claude Desktop MCP config for the Nvoy agent server. Merge the chosen server block into claude_desktop_config.json (Settings > Developer > Edit Config), keep only ONE, and replace the placeholders. The agent's key IS its identity — a delegator grants scopes to its npub, printed on the server's first stderr boot line. Build the server first: `cd nvoy/mcp && npm install` (the prepare script runs tsc).
//recommended: Standing agent — key on disk only as a NIP-49 ncryptsec, decrypted at boot. Create the file with the console's Print/Protect flow or any NIP-49 tool.

mcpServers.//alt-nsec: Convenient but leaves a raw key in the config/environment — see SECURITY.md. Fine for a throwaway demo agent.
mcpServers.//alt-npx: If you built and installed the tarball globally (`cd nvoy/mcp && npm pack && npm i -g ./nvoy-mcp-0.1.0.tgz`), the bin `nvoy-mcp` replaces the node+path command.
